text:
sara: Acme Tech seeing 429s when many CI jobs prefetch ephemeral tokens. They run ~40 parallel jobs with prefetch=true.

leo: Logs?

sara: "[WARN] 429 Too Many Requests - /v1/ephemeral_tokens (x6)".

leo: Classic stampede. Short fixes: 1) add single-flight token fetch so only one request per process; 2) exponential backoff with jitter; 3) stagger runner start times by hashing build id; 4) request a tenant-scoped burst from infra for the rollout.

eng-infra-bot: Please open BR and include tenant id.

sara: BR-10021 opened. Asking infra for a 10min burst. Sending client patch and staging guidance to Acme.

ratebot: [alert] tenant acme-tech ephemeral_token rate spike 9x baseline. Auto-throttle applied.

sara: Adding a short CS playbook entry: "prefetch race during onboarding" and will collect their CI config for a postmortem.

leo: Ops note: consider adding a Retry-After + jitter header on ephemeral endpoints to discourage synchronized retries. I'll file an RFC.
